title: Identity stack publicly includes myCoyote portal and DUO multi-factor authentication
summary: ITS publishes About myCoyote, portal/mobile app guides, and DUO MFA requirements/setup. Campus identity therefore binds students across portal services under MFA -- increasing both security and cross-system linkage of activity.

school_action: Publish the SSO attribute release matrix for major apps.
